title: After a batch merge, merge --confirm prints the idle-lanes report, or says the pass is owed
why: Runner 10 has never run the archive pass after a merge (decision session-tiers, archiving lanes), because it had no live file. The pass rests on the runner remembering a second command.
note: After a successful batch merge, merge --confirm reads the live file from origin/roadmap:roadmap/live/live.json. If its readAt is after the merge base's time, it prints the --idle-lanes report; if not, it prints one line saying the pass is owed and the file is stale. Red test first. Sibling of step batch-runner-start-names-idle-lanes (doing), which only names the command in the start text. Triage commits the live file at that path at each batch merge (from 00:44 CST Nov 13).
